pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5 10.exd5 Nxd5 11.Nxc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 targeted a c6-pawn before Black has recaptured; the overview said White shatters Black's structure, missing the 12.Nxd5 or 12.Bd4 choice; plan 4 had Black aiming for an endgame a pawn down. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5: 12.Bd4 e5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bh6 with the bishop on d4; plan 2 relied on a c-file closed by the c6-pawn. Rewrote plans 1 and 2 around 13.Bc5 and the half-open b-file.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5: 12.Bd4 e5 13.Bc5 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the knight via e2 and the queen via h2; plan 2 had c-file play and ...Rxc3 with the c-file closed; plan 4 had the g7-bishop pressing the queenside through the e5-pawn (reviewer). Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 around Ne4 and the b-file.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O d5: 12.Nxd5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bh6 after the queen has left d2; plan 2 had ...Rxc3 and missed the known 13...Qc7 14.Qxa8 Bf5 attack. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O Nxd4 10.Bxd4 Be6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bh6 with the bishop on d4; plan 2 called the half-open c-file open and had ...Rxc3. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O Nxd4: 11.Kb1
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bh6 with the bishop on d4. Rewrote plan 1.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, Yugoslav, 9.O-O-O Nxd4: 11.Kb1 Qc7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Bh6 with the bishop on d4; plan 2 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had sacrifices Bxh7+ and Nxe6 that no piece can make; plan 4 had ...Rxc3 and named g7 as a move. Rewrote plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack, Byrne Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 called the half-open c-file open and missed the Byrne idea ...a5-a4 against the bishop on b3; plan 4 named g7 as a move. Rewrote plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Yugoslav Attack, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Qh2 with the h-pawn at home; plan 3 had ...Rxc3; plan 4 named g7 as a move. Rewrote plans 2-4.
